Role.UnsetHint: This world has no role yet. Choose Home world for a campaign world that owns real characters, or Hub world for the always-online world where players edit copies.
Role.HomeHint: This world owns the real characters. It sends characters marked as in use to the hub and approves changes players submit there.
Role.HubHint: This world holds copies of characters from home worlds. Players edit them here and submit changes back for approval.

Menu.Name: Character Hub
Menu.Label: Configure
Menu.Hint: Set this world's role (home or hub), the Worker URL, and the API key.
Menu.Title: Character Hub configuration

Settings.WorldRoleHint: Changing the role reloads the world for everyone.
Settings.HomeWorldIdHint: Generated once for this world and never changed. The hub uses it to know which world a character came from.
Settings.HomeWorldIdPending: Generated when you save with the Home world role.
Settings.WorkerUrlHint: The address of your Character Hub Cloudflare Worker, starting with https://.
Settings.ApiKeyHint: The key the Worker gave this world when it was registered. Players in this world can read it, so the Worker only lets it do what players need.
Settings.ApiKeyHintHome: The key the Worker gave this world when it was registered. It is saved in this browser only, so players never see it. Enter it once on each browser you run this world from.

Notify.RoleUnset: Character Hub: this world has no role yet. Open Game Settings, then Configure Settings, then Character Hub to choose one.
Notify.BadWorkerUrl: Character Hub: the Worker URL must start with https:// (or http://localhost for testing).
